deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.description: Deleting your account ends your access to iZero.

dialog.title: Delete account?
dialog.consequences: Your account will be deleted and you will lose access immediately. Your data will remain stored and your email cannot be used for a new registration. The account cannot be restored.
dialog.adminAccount: An administrator account cannot be deleted.
dialog.unknown: We couldn't confirm whether your account was deleted. Try signing in later to check.
